Gabe Dixon | Gabe Dixon is a Nashville-based artist.  His music is piano-driven.  He found his beginnings with the five piece Nashville based country band, Six Shooter. Yambo Records | Yambo Records was a blues record label based in Chicago, Illinois.  It was founded by arranger and composer Willie Dixon in the late 1960s after he left Chess Records. Dumb Drum Records | Dumb Drum Records was a independent record label founded in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. The label was founded in Munich in 1996 as an affiliate of label Disko B.  It is now based in Berlin and is Germany's most successful electronic music record label, specialising in electro, house and techno with 80's pop and disco influences.  "Gigolo" has released records by Dave Clarke, Jeff Mills, DJ Hell, David Carretta, Miss Kittin & The Hacker, Kiko & Gino S., DJ Naughty, The Penelopes, The Advent, Dopplereffekt, Terrence Fixmer, Japanese Telecom, Fischerspooner, Tiga, Belgian Dj Valium, Princess Superstar and Vitalic.
Mas Ysa | Mas Ysa is the stage name of Thomas Arsenault, an artist.  A native of Montreal, Mas Ysa began writing electronic music in high school while living in São Paulo, Brazil and later attended the Oberlin Conservatory of Music where he studied Modern Composition.  Mas Ysa is managed by Rich Zerbo, founder of the NYC-based record label The Social Registry.
